description:
Start making alternate sets of a screenshot project to test against it with Apple's Product Page Optimization. Apple runs the test; these are the treatments you add in App Store Connect. Returns immediately: concepts take under a minute and one-change variants about 2 minutes, so call get-variants next, which waits for it.

mode:
- explore (default): up to 3 bold concepts. Each is one idea about why people install, built from 2 or 3 changes (a new headline angle, a different opening card, a new palette, how the phones sit). Test the one you believe in most against the original: a new or small app's test can only detect a large difference.
- refine: one change per variant (headline angle, opening card, look, or phones), so a win says exactly what worked. For an app with steady product page traffic, or a concept that already won.

Steer it (optional):
- idea: one line of the owner's own idea, e.g. "lead with the review card". In explore the first concept is built from it; in refine it is one more variant on top of the picked axes. Either way it uses only what the set already says.
- axes (refine): exactly which things to change, one variant each: hook, lead, visual, device.

Every variant keeps the project's real app screens, keeps its copy readable and its phones visible; any variant that fails those checks is refunded. Costs 5 credits per variant, charged at the start. Apple tests up to 3 treatments and Google Play 2, so an iOS set holds at most 3 variants and an Android set 2. Apple Watch sets cannot have variants: Apple does not test Watch product pages.

axes.description: One change each (refine) only: exactly which things to change, one variant each: hook (headline angle), lead (first card), visual (colours), device (phones). A kind the set cannot take is refused before any credit is charged.

count.description: How many to make. Default: as many as are left (Apple tests 3 treatments, Google Play 2).

idea.description: One line of the owner's own idea to test, e.g. "lead with the review card". In explore the first concept is built from it; in refine it is one more variant on top of the picked axes. Uses only what the set already says.

mode.description: explore (default): bold concepts, test one at a time. refine: one change per variant.

project_id.description: The project (the original set) to make variants of
